Azure Network Security and IAM Configuration Lab

Bahjet Mohammed · October 8, 2026

Project summary

I configured an Azure virtual network and subnet, attached a network security group with source-restricted SSH rules, created a user-assigned managed identity, assigned the Reader role at resource-group scope, and reviewed the role-assignment activity log.

The intended SSH policy permits the specified source before the broader deny rule. Default inbound and outbound NSG rules remain present. No custom outbound rules were added.

The managed identity has an active, permanent Reader assignment scoped to rg-cloud-security-lab. My user account retains an inherited subscription Owner assignment. I used a managed identity after the student directory blocked access to user creation; this lab does not demonstrate Entra user administration.

Audit evidence

The Activity log showed Create role assignment with status Succeeded. Its details identify my student account as the initiator and October 8, 2026 at 1:29:29 PM EDT as the timestamp. The resource path identifies a role assignment under rg-cloud-security-lab. The event summary does not populate its Role or Scope fields; the IAM screenshot supplies the Reader role and resource-group scope evidence.

Validation and limitations

  • Verified resource inventory, configured rule values, subnet association, active Reader assignment, and activity-log record through Azure portal screenshots.
  • No VM or network interface was deployed for this lab. Live SSH allow/deny behavior was not tested.
  • The managed identity was not attached to a running workload. Token acquisition and allowed/denied API operations were not tested.
  • The lab was kept to configuration resources to meet a free-services constraint. No billing screenshot was collected; zero actual charges have not been independently verified.

Skills demonstrated

Azure resource organization, virtual networking, NSG rule configuration, resource-group RBAC scoping, managed identity creation, and administrative change auditing.

Portfolio description

Configured an Azure VNet and subnet with an associated NSG restricting inbound SSH by source IP, assigned resource-group Reader access to a managed identity, and documented role changes through Azure Activity log evidence.
